text: I wander through spaces that feel dedicated to the pursuit and presentation of knowledge. The glass-walled meeting room evokes a sense of anticipation and quiet focus—a place waiting for thoughtful exchanges. The vibrant R+D wall pulls at my curiosity, inviting me to ponder the ceaseless dance between human innovation and the unknown. I feel inspired, both humbled and invigorated, in an environment charged with the promise of discovery.
